body.statement: Can the handle \(H_{\mathrm{transfer}}\) be completed, without using a formula for \(R_n^{\mathrm{NP}}\), so that for \(q<q_0\) and \(\rho_n^{\mathrm{priv}}<c b_n\) there exists one \(\epsilon_n\)-differentially private estimator satisfying \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_H}\mathbb E_P|T_{\mathrm{DP}}-\tau_P(x_0)|\le C\max\{R_n^{\mathrm{NP}},\rho_n^{\mathrm{priv}}\}\)?
body.justification: This is the only remaining step from the matched privacy-leading theorem to a global incremental-price decomposition with a symbolic nonprivate benchmark.
body.gap: Kennedy's oracle inequalities do not imply neighboring-dataset stability, and Niu et al.'s sample-splitting guarantee does not transfer arbitrary nonprivate minimax risk.
body.consumer: A positive answer makes any future exact-uniform nonprivate improvement automatically compatible with the sharp privacy price; a negative answer identifies the necessary stability information beyond minimax risk.

obligation.what_is_open: Construct, in the below-elbow privacy-inactive regime, one private estimator with risk at most \(C\max\{R_n^{\mathrm{NP}},\rho_n^{\mathrm{priv}}\}\) without substituting a formula for \(R_n^{\mathrm{NP}}\).
obligation.obstruction: The scalar minimax value \(R_n^{\mathrm{NP}}\) contains no neighboring-dataset stability information. The frozen handle names a desired rewrite but supplies neither an explicit nearly minimax nonprivate estimator whose local score has the required bounded block representation nor a theorem implying such a representation. The proved projection estimator is controlled only by \(b_n\), and the excluded queued sparse-component converse cannot be assumed to identify \(b_n\) with \(R_n^{\mathrm{NP}}\).
obligation.attempted: Direct output perturbation fails because a generic bounded nonprivate estimator can have order-one replacement sensitivity. Sample-and-aggregate changes the effective sample size and no frozen condition compares \(R_m^{\mathrm{NP}}\) to \(R_n^{\mathrm{NP}}\). Rewriting the displayed second-order estimator succeeds only at its proved benchmark \(b_n\), not at an arbitrary symbolic minimax risk.
obligation.partial_result: The proved envelopes give \(c\max\{R_n^{\mathrm{NP}},\rho_n^{\mathrm{priv}}\}\le R_n^{\mathrm{DP}}\le C\max\{b_n,\rho_n^{\mathrm{priv}}\}\), and hence the desired symbolic comparison whenever \(q\ge q_0\) or \(\rho_n^{\mathrm{priv}}\gtrsim b_n\).  In the remaining region \(q<q_0\) and \(\rho_n^{\mathrm{priv}}\ll b_n\), the frozen core supplies neither a same-class proof that \(b_n\lesssim R_n^{\mathrm{NP}}\) nor a stability property of a nearly minimax nonprivate estimator.
